content_of_post_to_answer: How can one not feel worthless in life?
answer: Feeling worthless often begins when self-worth gets tied to usefulness, achievement, approval, or comparison. The problem isn't that you have too little value; it's that you're using a measuring system that keeps changing. A bad day can make you less productive, but it doesn't make you less human. I've written more about this pattern on my profile if you want to go deeper. Your worth should not have to be earned every morning.
